title: agy-lane.sh populates each sandboxed lane clone with fetch +refs/*:refs/*: every ref of the shared checkout, so 3 concurrent lanes near-OOMed lambda
evidence: ~/.claude/skills/paiml-implement/scripts/agy-lane.sh:1108 (sha256 7bbf808143f44ca3) runs git -C $wt fetch --update-head-ok $repo +refs/*:refs/*. The aprender checkout carries 7214 refs over a 2.04 GiB pack (git for-each-ref | wc -l; git count-objects -vH, 2026-09-26). The cop (aprender-77) relayed infra-27 observing 17-19G per lane for the 3 #4428 delta lanes at 4fad4d50a, serialized with SIGSTOP/SIGCONT to avoid OOM. A lane only needs the reviewed head, the diff base and the default branch (origin/<default> is resolved in the brief).
repro: bash ~/.claude/skills/paiml-implement/scripts/agy-lane.sh --mode plan --repo-root <aprender worktree> ... x3 concurrently; watch RSS of the three git fetch/pack-objects children
fix: fetch only the base, the head and refs/heads/<default> + refs/remotes/origin/<default> (the refs the brief names), not +refs/*:refs/*
